title: Required floor drain in basement
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)

facts.text: A residential duplex has an in-ground basement and crawlspace. The crawlspace contains a furnace and service water heater with a floor drain; the adjoining basement is about 1.5 m lower and has no floor drain.
The basement is below the sanitary sewer connection and below the storm-sewer invert, so plumbing facilities require a lift pump and a floor drain would also need pumping.
The disputed sentence requires a basement floor drain where gravity drainage to sewer, ditch or dry well is possible.
